meta.source: DFL/IDSSE open dataset: 7 Bundesliga matches 2022/23, tracking (25 fps) + event data (Figshare item 28196177)
meta.licence: Contains data from the Deutsche Fußball Liga (DFL), published as open data by Bassek, M. et al. (2025), Scientific Data, doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Coordinates transformed (attack normalised left to right).
meta.coordinates: metres, origin bottom-left, x 0-105, y 0-68; attacking team always attacks left to right
meta.pids: A<jersey> = attacking team, D<jersey> = defending team (per moment; names in moment.names)
meta.value_formula:
Score one passing option on 0-100 (higher = better).

        lane     = clip(lane_open      / lane_full_m)
        space    = clip(receiver_space / space_full_m)
        prog     = clip((progress - progress_min_m) / (progress_max_m - progress_min_m))
        base     = 100 * (w_lane*lane + w_progress*prog + w_space*space)
        blocked  = clip(lane_open / lane_block_m)          # 0 = defender on the line
        penalty  = min(long_pass_max_pts, long_pass_pts_per_m * max(0, dist - long_pass_from_m))
        value    = clip(base * blocked - penalty, 0, 100)
meta.forward_first_rule:
Forward-first rule: a backward pass may only be the best option when every
    forward lane is blocked.  If any forward option has lane_open >= FORWARD_OPEN_LANE_M,
    each backward option's value is capped 1 point below the best such forward option.
meta.offside_rule:
x beyond which an attacker is offside (attack -> +x), or None in his own half.

    Law 11: in the opponents' half and nearer to their goal line than both the ball and the
    second-last opponent.  Judged at the moment you would pass (the reception frame).
    Returns max(second-last defender x, ball x, halfway line) + OFFSIDE_TOL_M. (OFFSIDE_TOL_M = 0.5). An offside option has value 0.
meta.direction_rule:
'forward' | 'sideways' | 'backward', by the angle to the opponent goal line.

    forward  = progress >= DIRECTION_MIN_M and within 60° of straight ahead (progress >= dist/2)
    backward = progress <= -DIRECTION_MIN_M and within 60° of straight back
    sideways = everything else
meta.difficulty_rule:
'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard'.

    n_close  = options whose value is within 10 points of the best (best included)
    points   = min(n_close - 1, 2)                 # 0: one obvious option ... 2: 3+ options
             + (2 if pressure_m < 2.5 else 1 if pressure_m < 5 else 0)
    easy     = one obvious option and points <= 1
    hard     = points >= 3
    medium   = everything else
meta.lane_open_rule:
Minimum distance from any defender to the pass segment src->dst.

    Defenders *behind* the passer (projection onto the pass direction < 0) are
    ignored: they cannot intercept a ball travelling away from them, and otherwise
    a single presser next to B would make every lane look closed.
meta.notes: actual.intended_pid = receiver for completed passes; for failed passes the teammate closest to the ball line (or null). pro_was_best compares intended_pid with best_option_pid. Options are measured at reception_frame_index. Frames start up to 2 s before the pass 1 kick (pass1_frame_index) and end 0.5 s after reception. actual.end = where the ball was taken over (or went out of play); actual.outcome = received | intercepted | out | loose; actual.taker = {pid, t: seconds after reception, run: [[x, y], ...] his path from the reception frame to the takeover at 5 fps} or null. context = match facts (DFL match information), the attacking side, the score (home:away) just before pass 1 and the match minute. names = {pid: {name, pos}} (DFL short name; position from the line-up, English abbreviation, null for substitutes without one). Takeover rule: A player takes the ball when it is low (< 2.5 m) and within TOUCH_M of him AND it either stays at his feet for CONTROL_S, or leaves his reach on a different course (turned by > TURN_DEG, or speed changed by SPEED_RATIO): a ball rolling past someone's feet untouched does not count. The ball going out of play ends the search.

game_value_model.note: options[].value / best_option_pid here are the heuristic used to SELECT moments. The game values every pass by expected value instead (src/game/value.ts): EV = P(success) * (EPV(target) - EPV(ball)) - (1 - P(success)) * EPV_opponent(target), shown on 0-100.
game_value_model.p_success: Spearman-style logistic of the race margin (src/game/space.ts), bias 1.0 s, sigma 0.95 s, fitted on 991 real DFL passes (calibrate_pass_model.py, pass_model_calibration.json)
